about_the_game:
This game is a trial version of the upcoming title “Gravity Shooter.”

It is intended for gathering feedback and bug reports from players.
Please note that the content of this demo may differ from the final release version.

Control gravity, roll the sphere, and crush the swarming enemies!
This is a fast–paced action game that blends gravity manipulation with the addictive survival-style gameplay of “Vampire Survivors.”

  • Gravity-Based Action
    You take command of a device that generates gravity, allowing you to freely control a massive sphere as your primary weapon. Roll it across the battlefield to crush enemies, knock back waves of attackers, and protect key objectives. The intuitive controls deliver an immediate sense of impact and satisfaction.

  • Weapons, Skills, and Builds
    Defeated enemies drop new weapons and passive skills. The way you combine them dramatically changes your attack style and overall strategy. Experiment with different builds every run, and discover powerful synergies that let you push further against the endless hordes.

  • Varied Stages and Unique Gimmicks
    Multiple stages are available, each with their own hazards, gimmicks, and enemy types. Adapt your tactics to overcome unfamiliar challenges, from environmental traps to enemy swarms that demand quick reactions.

  • Replayability and Challenge
    With its roguelike elements and evolving build options, every session offers a fresh experience. How long can you survive against overwhelming odds? Test your reflexes, your creativity, and your ability to master gravity itself.
